Run the SCI reference pipeline and verify output

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_scid_example.Rd

Runs the full SCI pipeline on mimic_iv_demo using the bundled SCI ICD files as the reference implementation. Useful for verifying the package works correctly after installation or changes.

Usage

run_scid_example(
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  src_name = "mimic_iv_demo",
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  import_scope = NULL
)

Arguments

db_name

Optional Postgres database to write to. If NULL, uses the active project config, then "rendehr".

base_dir

Project root with MIMIC-IV demo parquet data.

src_name

Source to run. Default "mimic_iv_demo".

raw_data_root

Optional parent storage-root override for raw source data. The source directory is derived as {raw_data_root}/{src_name}.

overwrite

Passed to run_one_source(). Default FALSE (resume/skip mode). Set TRUE to force a full rebuild of the scid example.

import_scope

Passed to run_one_source() (and on to import_cohort_general()). Default NULL: full patient history, every hospitalization a matched patient ever had. Pass "hospital" to widen only to other ICU stays within the same hospitalization, or "icu" to narrow to just the matched ICU stays themselves. Changing this always requires a full rebuild (overwrite = TRUE).

Value

Invisibly returns a list with cohort_info, heart_rate, and flat_tab.

Details

Requires the MIMIC-IV demo raw data under the project's raw data root. The database is the project config's db_name (or db_name), not the target of ehr_connect().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_connect("scid_example", creds)
run_scid_example(base_dir = "/path/to/project")
} # }
